title: GTA VI hauls in $3.79 billion US in massive 1st day of sales
summary: Criminal duo Lucia and Jason's blitz through Vice City in Grand Theft Auto VI helped Take-Two Interactive, the publisher of the blockbuster game that is now a global cultural phenomenon, rake in…

blocks.text: Business·New

Criminal duo Lucia and Jason's blitz through Vice City in Grand Theft Auto VI helped Take-Two Interactive, the publisher of the blockbuster game that is now a global cultural phenomenon, rake in nearly $4 billion US in first-day sales.
Game said to have had production cost of $1 billion US or more
It’s been a long wait for GTA VI — but it's finally here

Take-Two Interactive, the ‌parent company of GTA developer Rockstar Games, is not a household name despite its portfolio of massive hits, including the Red Dead Redemption franchise and the NBA 2K basketball series.

GTA VI sold 32.5 million units in pre-release and garnered $3.79 US billion in day-one retail sales, Rockstar Games said ​on Friday. That is nearly five times the roughly $800 million ​— a figure unadjusted for inflation — that GTA V made on its first day in 2013.
Analytics firm Sensor Tower estimated ​the company sold 24.5 million copies of GTA VI and made $2.36 billion US in pre-order revenue.

blocks.text: Take-Two ⁠had stayed tight-lipped about GTA ⁠VI demand since it opened for pre-orders in ‌June, limiting commentary to saying demand has been "unprecedented" or "far exceeding expectations."

"The title is so widely anticipated, consumers appear very, very excited, and all the press so far has been universally positive, but we still aren't ready to declare victory," CEO Strauss Zelnick said on Take-Two's earnings ⁠call earlier this month.
"We tend to avoid claiming success before it occurs," he said.
Massive hype
Take-Two has shelled out an estimated $1 billion US in production costs for GTA VI, making it one of the ‌most expensive entertainment projects.
A man is seen playing the newly released Grand Theft Auto VI video game at a launch event in London, England, on Thursday. (Kirsty Wigglesworth/The Associated Press)
Sensor Tower estimates that the game's promotional trailer, GTA VI "Extended Look," on Netflix in August helped drive a sixfold jump in pre-orders.
In Miami, which Vice City is based on, the city's NBA team celebrated the release on Wednesday with a Vice City-themed match.
Over the weekend, ​the company is hosting GTA VI: The Festival, with a star-studded lineup that includes Grammy-winning rapper Cardi B, hip-hop record ⁠producer Metro Boomin and rapper Travis Scott.
Anticipation for PC launch of game
Investors have been waiting to hear from Take-Two ⁠about its plans for a PC launch of GTA VI and an online version rollout.
The online, ⁠multiplayer ⁠component of a videogame is crucial ​in turning the title into a recurring revenue engine.
Some industry analysts are expecting the PC launch and online mode ​in 2027.
Brokerage TD Cowen named ⁠Take-Two one of its "Best Ideas" for 2027, with its analyst Doug Creutz upbeat about the company's financial prospects when the game releases online.

"The potential ceiling for GTA VI's long-term recurrent consumer spending performance is very high... 'when' and 'how big' the next GTA Online will be is the most important question for the stock, more so than GTA VI ⁠unit sales."
